newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco Products files $200 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco Products files $200 mln shelf debt.

text.p: Sonoco Products Co filed a shelf registration Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $200 million in debt securities.
The Hartsville, S.C.,-based packaging products company said when combined with previous registrations, it will have up to $250 million of debt securities available for sale.
The company said it will use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures and repayment or reduction of bank debt and commercial paper obligations.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
